label: Payment and appointment requests carried as obligations (hypothetical)
rationale: HYPOTHETICAL numbers, for James to review. Tracking only (P-LOAD-02): the ledger reads the organisation-availability work and changes nothing in any run. Finance's reference output (100 payments) equals its new requests per step, so a backlog built in a bad step is never cleared within the run: the work's reference output does not follow the backlog. Every claim is assumed, so every result is conditional.
